name: yammine-market-weekly-deals
description: Yammine Market Mansourieh: 4 vertical promo variants for the weekly in-store deals campaign, built with Remotion

scripts.render:general: remotion render src/index.ts WeeklyDeals-General out/yammine-general-raw.mp4 && scripts/master.sh out/yammine-general-raw.mp4 out/yammine-general.mp4
scripts.render:beverages: remotion render src/index.ts WeeklyDeals-Beverages out/yammine-beverages-raw.mp4 && scripts/master.sh out/yammine-beverages-raw.mp4 out/yammine-beverages.mp4
scripts.render:fresh: remotion render src/index.ts WeeklyDeals-Fresh out/yammine-fresh-raw.mp4 && scripts/master.sh out/yammine-fresh-raw.mp4 out/yammine-fresh.mp4
scripts.render:flash: remotion render src/index.ts WeeklyDeals-FlashSale out/yammine-flash-sale-raw.mp4 && scripts/master.sh out/yammine-flash-sale-raw.mp4 out/yammine-flash-sale.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render:general && npm run render:beverages && npm run render:fresh && npm run render:flash
